reasoning: The gazette content is a formal notice to convene a meeting for the election to fill the vacant position of Chairman of a specific local authority (Maritimepattu Pradeshiya Sabha). This directly concerns an electoral process at the local government level, falling under the definition of "Election announcements and schedules" for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
